//: Change-scope config for the compose-preview apply action (see .github/actions/apply/README.md). PRs whose changes all live inside modules under scopedRoots render only those modules plus their Gradle dependents; PRs that only touch ignorePaths skip the preview pipelines. Non-rendering product surfaces are safe here because their own required build/test jobs still compile them. Anything else — the plugin, render-facing CLI, renderers, build wiring, CI — always triggers a full render.
